conclusion: No unresolved blocking defect found in the reviewed hashes for a quiescent current Windows checkout using the PowerShell preflight/removal boundary. This is bounded source and synthetic-fixture evidence, not execution authorization or a universal filesystem safety proof.
scope: prepare_retirement.py, retirement_custody.py, apply_retirement.ps1 and build_catalog.py; all four fully read, current plan/lesson/report pins independently checked, synthetic Windows fixtures only.

file_reviews.assessment: Complete source reviewed: selects only stub/trivial verdicts, binds current report fields, requires exact files/directories and current/archive bytes, retains lessons and freezes the plan. It cannot authorize removal without PowerShell checks.

Complete source reviewed: binds receipt to plan and lessons, distinguishes completed versus explicitly incomplete pilots, verifies archive hash and individual entry bytes, and rejects unreceipted missing evidence or escaped paths.

Complete source reviewed: defaults to no removal; pins fixed roots, exact numbered-child paths, report decisions, file/dir inventory and archive; rejects reparse points and alternate streams; rechecks each pilot before literal-path recursive removal and records intent/completion.

Complete source reviewed: evidence hashes flow through EvidenceStore and remain checked against migration/source inventory; archived and incomplete pilot status propagate while initial triage stays distinct from whole-directory substantive review.

findings.issue: A stale catalog verdict could select a pilot whose freshly hashed report now recommended retention.
findings.resolution: Preparation compares the complete retained row fields with the uniquely matching current report row; PowerShell independently checks report digest and id/path/verdict/rationale before removal.

findings.issue: Removal originally preceded the receipt record; partial deletion or a process interruption could leave missing files unavailable to the archive evidence reader.
findings.resolution: The script records a single removal_intent before Remove-Item, then atomically replaces it with the completed row. EvidenceStore permits exact manifest/hash-checked archive fallback for explicit incomplete intent while preserving live evidence and incomplete status.
findings.limit: No production deletion, abrupt process kill or power-loss fault injection was executed. The script intentionally refuses a second Apply after a receipt exists; recovery/resumption requires inspection.

findings.issue: Unarchived NTFS alternate data streams on files or the selected directory passed normal byte/hash/ZIP checks and would be discarded by recursive removal.
findings.resolution: PowerShell checks the target and every descendant for non-default streams in both preflight and the immediately-before-removal Test-CurrentPilot call. Preparation alone does not check streams and explicitly requires that PowerShell boundary.

findings.issue: Unknown empty directories were outside the file-only census and would silently disappear.
findings.resolution: Preparation compares exact directory sets; PowerShell compares current descendants with the original directory inventory embedded in the hash-pinned recovery ZIP.

findings.issue: After removal intent, EvidenceStore originally accepted corruption of the retained-lessons file while advertising preserved_mechanism pointers.
findings.resolution: EvidenceStore checks the frozen lesson path, SHA-256 and exact unique lesson-to-plan identifier bijection before accepting any receipt.

residual_limits_and_followups: Quiescence is an execution precondition: the script rechecks immediately before removal but does not lock every source inode/directory against concurrent writers or link substitution. Stop readers/writers before Apply; no hostile concurrency proof is claimed.
The junction fixture could not be created (New-Item: Access is denied), so link rejection is source-reviewed plus the parent's production scan, not a fresh injected-junction test.

The receipt replacement is atomic at the filename level in the source, but no power-loss/disk-flush guarantee or crash fault-injection test was established. The full pinned recovery archive remains necessary for manual recovery.

After any receipt exists, Apply intentionally refuses rerun. An incomplete operation should be inspected and restored/resumed through an explicit recovery procedure; automatic restart was not implemented or claimed.

The 77,421,556-byte archive is outside the repository at an absolute local visualization path. It must be retained and transferred with its SHA for another checkout/machine to rebuild archived evidence; Git alone does not carry these bytes.

The review validates eligibility against existing triage decisions, not the scientific quality of every retired file. Original report semantic-coverage limits remain in force; no candidate verdict is upgraded to mathematical evidence.
No model/provider calls, protected benchmark or private answer-key reads, production Apply, source fixes or corpus deletions were performed by this reviewer. Parent made the infrastructure repairs.
